confirmQuestion.caster: Do you confirm you're ready to cast this match?
confirmQuestion.team: Do you confirm your team is complete and ready to play?
confirmQuestion.referee: Do you confirm you're ready to referee this match?

errors.MATCH_NOT_IN_LOBBY: This match isn't in its launch phase.
errors.MATCH_NOT_LAUNCHABLE: This match can't be launched: its two entrants aren't known yet, or it's over.
errors.MATCH_ALREADY_LAUNCHED: This match has already been launched.
errors.MATCH_NOT_LAUNCHED: The match hasn't been launched yet: every party must declare itself ready.
errors.MATCH_NOT_STARTED: The match hasn't started yet: the score opens at its start time.
errors.MATCH_NOT_IN_LAUNCH: The score can only be reported once the match is launched: schedule it or wait for its start time. A forfeit is still possible.
errors.NOT_MATCH_PARTY: You're neither playing nor casting this match.
errors.NOT_TEAM_READY_ROLE: Only the captain, a manager or the owner can declare the team ready.
errors.NOT_CASTER: Casting a match requires the caster role.
errors.CASTER_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: To cast a match, verify your Discord tag and link your Battle.net account from your profile.
errors.CASTER_IS_PLAYER: You're playing this match: you can't cast it.
errors.STREAM_NOT_FOUND: This stream no longer exists on this match: pick another one.
errors.INVALID_STREAM_URL: Stream link not recognized (Twitch, YouTube or Kick expected).
errors.INVALID_HOST_TEAM: The host team must be one of the match's two entrants.
errors.fallback: The action couldn't go through. Try again in a moment.
errors.NOT_REFEREE: Refereeing a match requires the referee role.
errors.REFEREE_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: To referee a match, certify your Discord tag and link your Battle.net account from your profile.
errors.REFEREE_IS_PLAYER: This account plays this match: it cannot referee it.
errors.REFEREE_OBJECTION: This account has an upheld objection to refereeing: it can no longer referee a match.
errors.REFEREE_OBJECTION_FAILED: The objection is upheld, but the referee could not be removed from all their matches: uphold it again to retry.
errors.INVALID_REFEREE_OBJECTION: Invalid choice for the referee's objection.
errors.MATCH_ALREADY_REFEREED: This match already has a referee.
errors.NOT_MATCH_REFEREE: You are not refereeing this match.
errors.INVALID_FIRST_MAP: Invalid map name (64 characters at most).
errors.INVALID_ROUND_MAPS: Invalid maps: 9 maps at most per tournament round, 20 at most per pool, 64 characters per name.
errors.INVALID_MAP_PICK: This map is not in the tournament round's pool.
errors.NOT_MAP_PICKER: Only the referees and, when the match is self-managed, its teams choose the map.
errors.ROUND_MAPS_SET: This tournament round has its maps set for the whole round: reset the round to enter the map match by match.

launched: Every party is ready: the match is launched!
copyFailed: Couldn't copy: select the text by hand.
startsWhenReady: The match starts as soon as every party is ready.
notLeader: Your team's captain, a manager or the owner declares it ready.

status.launched: The match is launched — good game!

host: Hosts the game — creates the lobby
contactsAtLaunch: Contacts show up at launch — or right now through the match's “Contacts” action on the tournament page (under “More actions” if needed).
casterContactsAtLaunch: Their contacts show up at launch.
noCaster: No caster signed up: the match starts as soon as both teams are ready.
pushLead: Get notified when your next matches start, even with the site closed.

contacts.title: Contacts — {match}
contacts.lead: Shown to the members of both teams and the referees of this match — and, while the match is being played, its casters — to add each other in game and get organised. A caster's: to both teams and the other casters while the match is being played, to the referees from the moment both its opponents are known until its end.
contacts.noCaster: No caster signed up for this match.
contacts.casterLater: Their contacts will show once the match starts.
contacts.casterShown: The casters' contacts are now shown.
contacts.unavailable: This match's contacts aren't available to you right now (for the caster: once the match starts).
contacts.failed: Contacts could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

selfManaged: Self-managed match: no referee, the teams create and run the game themselves.
